existing_contract_connections.relationship: Bounded continuation of the earlier e275 Lens1 connected contract; no additional unique defect.
existing_contract_connections.trace: SceneTerrain.height_at accepts a typed ScenePlanPoint and returns Option<SupportElevation> from the terrain surface. In byte-identical ordinary locomotion source, the current foot position is admitted as a scene point, optional terrain elevation feeds ordinary_terrain_target, and measured limb segments and reachable pelvis shift precede retained signed pelvis movement. Enabled terrain begins with unavailable per-foot support and records a leg solve result only where a target exists; disabled terrain initializes semantic authored support weights, while solve influence is set to NONE when terrain is disabled or absent.
existing_contract_connections.solve_boundary: The newly read OrdinaryLeg::solve returns None if the needed rig chain, snapshot, measurement or analytic solve is unavailable. An ankle target within 0.0001 of the current ankle returns Some(weight) without a new analytic solve or slope alignment; otherwise a returned solution is applied, alignment is attempted, and weight is returned. The returned weight alone is neither an independently confirmed final contact nor proof that slope alignment ran.
existing_contract_connections.publication_boundary: The local OrdinaryLocomotionIkState is copied and only written back after memory.publish succeeds. The finite local root correction and per-leg native Transform mutations occur before that fallible publication, so the selected code does not promise a transactional whole-pose update; this observation alone does not establish a reachable error or a defect. Addition to the native transform is not itself proven finite merely because the local delta was checked.
existing_contract_connections.remaining: Actual terrain/rig admission, downstream solver/apply success semantics, native arithmetic bounds, publish rejection reachability, all other consumers and intentional error policy remain unresolved. The earlier e275 reviewer specifically left the child leg body unread; this new historical personal read fills that local body scope with byte identity at 95e and does not alter the original receipt.

existing_contract_connections.relationship: Bounded continuation of the earlier e275 Lens1 connected contract; no additional unique defect.
existing_contract_connections.trace: The selected presentation plugin orders terrain IK and later pose passes before transform propagation, and schedules raised-support refresh followed by animation diagnostics after propagation. The refresh requires a single terrain and the owner, rig and IK state; it observes optional propagated foot/toe positions and rotations and rejects nonfinite values before assigning those endpoint fields. After updating owner-frame continuity, it continues early when ordinary locomotion owns the pose. Other eligible paths call refresh_run_support; when initialized raised state and foot globals exist, the raised branch asks observed_support_weight for support using the actual ankle and typed terrain sample in Enabled mode.
existing_contract_connections.mode_and_limits: The separately inspected observed_support_weight helper returns optional ZERO/ONE for available enabled terrain samples; its disabled mode uses nominal semantic support intentionally. The selected raised refresh itself calls the helper with Enabled, and exits if a unique terrain is unavailable; do not infer that its disabled branch executes there. The ordinary-owner early continuation prevents claiming that this raised branch automatically overwrites ordinary support. The exact final capture/report/event consumers, native scheduler/lifecycle, all helper branches and actual rig admission remain open.
